description: Official ShoppDropp Apify Actors - Selected for all users
notes: These are the FIXED actors all ShoppDropp users will use for product research. Selection criteria: high run count, positive reviews, reasonable pricing, maintained actively.

tiktok.name: TikTok Scraper
tiktok.reason: Most popular TikTok scraper on Apify. 50K+ runs, scrapes hashtags, users, trends, and videos. Well maintained.

reddit.name: Reddit Posts & Comments Scraper
reddit.reason: Best Reddit scraper. Scrapes posts, comments, subreddits. Great for product discussions. 20K+ runs.

google_trends.name: Google Trends Scraper
google_trends.reason: Most reliable Google Trends scraper. Gets search interest data, regional trends, related queries.

amazon_products.name: Amazon Product Crawler
amazon_products.reason: The gold standard for Amazon scraping. 100K+ runs. Gets products, reviews, prices, bestsellers. Very reliable.

google_search.name: Google Search Results Scraper
google_search.reason: Official Apify actor. Scrapes Google search results, top sites, can be used to find competitor stores.

youtube.name: YouTube Scraper
youtube.reason: Scrapes YouTube videos, channels, comments. Good for finding product review videos.

instagram.name: Instagram Hashtag Scraper
instagram.reason: Official Apify actor. Scrapes Instagram posts by hashtags, great for product discovery.

ebay.name: eBay Scraper
ebay.reason: Good eBay scraper for competitor pricing and product availability.

phases.description: Quick trend detection across social and search data
Full market analysis of competitors and pricing
Check social proof and viral content for products

maximumResearch.description: All phases - Complete analysis including social validation

whyTheseActors: Selected based on: high run counts (10K-100K+), positive user reviews, active maintenance
Platform usage pricing means costs scale with compute used
All actors have free trials or low minimum costs
These are industry-standard scrapers used by thousands of companies
notes.maintenance: Actors should be reviewed quarterly. If an actor becomes unreliable, we switch to the next best alternative.
notes.costOptimization: Costs are estimates based on average runs. Actual costs depend on data volume and search complexity.
